mr_title: Polish 'Fix inconsistent ordering of config imports'

expected_issues.title: Config location properties lose per-location reverse-order precedence
expected_issues.description:
The location and additional-location arrays are now grouped in a single contributor rather than registered individually in reverse order. This changes the grouping of profile-specific and non-profile-specific configuration, not simply the order of two ordinary files.

The upstream regression test uses an active local profile with spring.config.location=optional:classpath:/,optional:file:<directory>/. The external application.properties should override classpath application-local.properties, but the new grouping lets the earlier profile-specific value win. Preserve separate reverse-registered contributors for location properties while keeping spring.config.import grouped.
